Users & Settings

💾 Data Backup & Restore

Complete data (CRM + HR Portal + access settings) in a single JSON file. Take a backup once every week/month. Restore uploads it back to Firebase.

⚠️ Restore replaces the current data with the backup file data — use with caution.

🔒 Call Date Lock (for RMs)

RM ke Follow-up form me Last Call aur Next Call date ki limit set karo. Isse pehle ya iske baad ki date RM daal nahi payega. Blank chhodo = us taraf koi limit nahi. (Admin par koi limit nahi lagti.)

✅ Rolling mode: limit har roz khud aage khisak jati hai — daily click karne ki zarurat nahi. Neeche aaj se kitne din ka gap allow karna hai wo daalo. Blank = us taraf koi limit nahi.
Example: -7 = 7 din pehle tak · 0 = aaj · 90 = aaj se 90 din baad tak.

📥 Equity Excel Import

Upload an Excel file with Asset Value and Last Trade Date. Matching will be done on Client Code or Mobile — if a match is found, the existing client will be updated; if not, a new client will be added.

Expected columns (header names flexible/auto-detect): Code (or Client Code), Name, Mobile, RM (required for new clients), Asset Value (or Holding/Portfolio Value), Last Trade Date (or Last Trade)
💡 Broker RMS Risk file (daily .xls with Clt Code / Risk Val columns) can also be dropped here — it's auto-detected and imports Ac Bal, Stk Val, Tot Expo, Risk Val & Risk % against each client.

📊 Drag the Equity Excel file here or click to browse

⇅ Equity — Bulk RM Update

Upload an Excel file with only Client Code and New RM. Matching will be done on Client Code (exact) — only the RM field will be updated, nothing else (Asset Value, Status, Remarks etc.) will be touched.

Expected columns (header names flexible/auto-detect): Client Code, New RM (Name column is optional and will be ignored)

🪪 Equity — Bulk PAN Update

Upload an Excel file with only Client Code and PAN. Matching will be done on Client Code (exact) — only the PAN field will be updated, nothing else (RM, Asset Value, Status, Remarks etc.) will be touched.

Expected columns (header names flexible/auto-detect): Client Code, PAN (Name column is optional and will be ignored)

⬇️ Download Template
📊 Drag the Excel file here or click to browse

🎂 Equity — Bulk DOB Update

Upload an Excel file with only Client Code and DOB. Matching will be done on Client Code (exact) — only the Date of Birth field will be updated, nothing else (RM, Asset Value, Status, Mobile, Remarks etc.) will be touched. Naye client add nahi honge.

Expected columns (header names flexible/auto-detect): Client Code, DOB (Name column optional — ignore ho jayega).
DOB format: 19561009 (YYYYMMDD), DD/MM/YYYY, ya Excel ka real date cell — sab chalega. 0 / NULL wali rows apne aap skip ho jayengi.

⬇️ Download Template
